page.overview:
What is Windy Heights West?

Windy Heights West is a location in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, which along with Windy Heights East comprise the highlands that surround the Village of Ambel. On its western side, these highlands are connected to the mountain path called Whispering Pass.

As the party makes way to the Village of Ambel, Fina asks Lid about her older brother, Evan, and Lasswell inquires if he is as money hungry as she is. Lid starts saying he is until she realizes Lasswell also called her money hungry, and goes on saying that perhaps he, as a Grandshelt knight, doesn't need gil and may have found his armor in a chest but it doesn't mean everyone is like him. Lid finishes her rant by saying she is nothing like her brother. Lasswell apologizes for making her shout. She denies shouting, all the while doing so, and excuses herself to 'mister perfect breeding! mister... blue eyes! mister hairdo!' and goes on walking, leaving Lasswell very confused.

As they advance though Windy Heights, Lid explains herself: she loves money but she would never thow away her dreams to obtain it, and that is the difference between her and Evan. As far as she knows, he became an airship technician for the military just to make more money, even though he wanted to become a Cid. They go on walking until they reach the village.
